    The proportionality step without exceptions #

    scalarProportionality: for a minimal representation-infinite distributive algebra there is a zero-detecting lift for which every non-interlaced contour is deep or has proportional values. Contours are deep or exceptional (deep_or_exc); an exceptional dumb-bell is unique and is made to commute by twisting its loops (db_lift); the Q₂' contours are made to commute one point at a time by twisting β or a (q2_lift).

    theorem LargeIndecomposable.scalarProportionality :
    ScalarProportionality

    The proportionality step ([mild] Theorem 3 with the exceptional contours made to commute): for a minimal representation-infinite distributive algebra there is a zero-detecting lift for which every non-interlaced contour is deep or has proportional values.
